title: Customer earns loyalty points on purchase
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty Points Accrual
  Scenario: Customer earns loyalty points on purchase
    Given a customer with an active loyalty account
    When the customer makes a purchase of $100
    Then the customer should earn loyalty points
    And the loyalty points balance should increase
rationale: Basic functionality test to verify that customers earn loyalty points when making purchases, which is the core requirement of a loyalty points accrual rule.
generationSummary: Loyalty points accrual rule - Test cases covering various scenarios for how loyalty points are earned and accumulated based on customer transactions and activities.

title: Loyalty points accrual is proportional to purchase amount
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty Points Accrual
  Scenario: Loyalty points accrual is proportional to purchase amount
    Given a customer with an active loyalty account
    When the customer makes a purchase of $50
    And the customer makes another purchase of $100
    Then the second purchase should accrue more loyalty points than the first purchase
rationale: Verifies that the accrual rule scales with transaction value, ensuring fair point distribution based on spending.

title: Multiple transactions accumulate loyalty points
gherkin:
Feature: Loyalty Points Accrual

    And the customer makes a purchase of $20
